
Various zero-modified gamma distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $\alpha$, $\beta$ and\ $p$.



```{r, ZMGDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Zero-modified exponential distributions."}
###  Parameters  ###
combos <- data.frame(
  p     = c(0.30, 0.30, 0.20, 0.20, 0.15, 0.15),
  alpha = c(1.50, 1.25, 1.50, 1.50, 2.50, 2.50),
  beta  = c(0.50, 0.75, 1.80, 1.20, 1.80, 1.20)
)
x_vals <- c(0, seq(0.01, 10, length.out = 500))

fig <- plot_ly(width = 650, height = 450)

###  Traces  ###
counter <- 1
for (k in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  P     <- combos$p[k]
  ALPHA <- combos$alpha[k]
  BETA  <- combos$beta[k]
  dens  <- (1 - P) * dgamma(x_vals, shape = ALPHA, scale = BETA)

  fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
    x = 0, y = P,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 12, color = "steelblue"),
    visible = (counter == 1),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    name = paste0("P(X=0) = ", round(P, 2))
  )
  fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
    x = x_vals, y = dens,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
    line = list(width = 2, color = "steelblue"),
    visible = (counter == 1),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
  counter <- counter + 2
}
total_traces <- counter - 1

###  Buttons  ###
buttons <- list()
for (k in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  P     <- combos$p[k]
  ALPHA <- combos$alpha[k]
  BETA  <- combos$beta[k]
  tidx  <- (k - 1) * 2 + 1
  vis   <- rep(FALSE, total_traces)
  vis[c(tidx, tidx + 1)] <- TRUE

  buttons[[k]] <- list(
    method = "update",
    args = list(
      list(visible = as.list(vis)),
      list(
        title = paste0("Zero-modified gamma:  p = ", P, ", \u03b1 = ", ALPHA, ", \u03b2 = ", BETA),
        annotations = list(list(
          x = 0.95, y = 0.95,
          xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
          text = paste0("P(X = 0) = ", round(P, 2), "<br>P(X > 0) = ", round(1 - P, 2)),
          showarrow = FALSE,
          xanchor = "right", yanchor = "top",
          font = list(size = 12, color = "black")
        ))
      )
    ),
    label = paste0("p=", P, ", \u03b1=", ALPHA, ", \u03b2=", BETA)
  )
}

top_row_buttons    <- buttons[1:3]
bottom_row_buttons <- buttons[4:6]

###  Layout  ###
fig <- fig %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Zero-modified gamma distribution", x = 0.5),
    xaxis = list(title = "x", range = c(-0.2, 10)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Density / P(X = 0)", range = c(0, 0.75)),
    margin = list(t = 50, b = 120),
    annotations = list(list(
      x = 0.95, y = 0.95,
      xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      text = paste0("P(X = 0) = ", round(combos$p[1], 2), "<br>P(X > 0) = ", round(1 - combos$p[1], 2)),
      showarrow = FALSE,
      xanchor = "right", yanchor = "top",
      font = list(size = 12, color = "black")
    )),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "buttons", direction = "right",
        x = 0, y = -0.18,
        xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top",
        buttons = top_row_buttons
      ),
      list(
        type = "buttons", direction = "right",
        x = 0, y = -0.30,
        xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top",
        buttons = bottom_row_buttons
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

fig
```
